title: The Lagos State Development and Property Corporation (LSDPC) has been tasked with helping to realize the state government's dream of providing housing for its citizens. The LSDPC has completed a housing project located at Owutu Estate in Ikorodu and is set to commission it soon. However, some state government staff who should have been allocated houses at the completed estate missed the opportunity due to bureaucratic delays. The LSDPC also explains that it received instructions from the Federal Mortgage Bank (FMB) late, which caused a delay in issuing certificates of occupancy to the allotees. The allotees whose bids did not succeed are awaiting compensation.
